elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
The cap is the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The cap is only payments made during the twelve months prior to the event; it omits payable fees, the USD 1,000,000 floor, and the greater-of formulation.

elements.element: The exclusion of indirect and consequential damages applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: Section 13.2 states that neither Customer nor M&I is liable for indirect, incidental, punitive, special, or consequential damages.

elements.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 13.4 expressly excludes breach of a party's confidentiality obligations from the limitation.

elements.element: Breach of data protection and security obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: No carve-out addresses data protection or security obligations.
Section 13.4 expressly excludes a party's indemnification obligations from the limitation.
Section 13.4 expressly excludes gross negligence from the limitation.
Section 13.4 expressly excludes “willful misconduct” from the limitation.
Fraud is not included in the listed carve-outs.

elements.element: Infringement of the other party's intellectual property is uncapped.
elements.evidence: No carve-out addresses infringement of the other party's intellectual property.

elements.element: Customer payment obligations are excluded from damages subject to the cap.
elements.evidence: The collection proviso exempts amounts due only from the one-year claim deadline, while Sections 11.1 and A exempt only specified termination fees from the cap; Customer payment obligations generally are not excluded.
